test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Pygmalion was written by GB Shaw.

options.text: GB Shaw was written by Pygmalion.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****GB Shaw wrote Pygmalion.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **passive voice.** As per the question we have to change it into** active voice.**</
